sources.title: Sakamata Chloe (1st costume)
sources.excerpt: It consists of an [[orca hood]] [[black collar|black]] [[animal collar]], an [[open jacket|open]] [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[black jacket|black]] [[two-sided jacket|two-sided]]  [[off-shoulder jacket]] held with a [[chest belt]], a [[white camisole|white]] [[frilled camisole]], black [[arm strap]]s, [[black gloves|black]] [[fingerless gloves]], [[multiple belts]] [[black belt]]s including a [[studded belt]], a [[plaid skirt|plaid]] [[red skirt|red]] [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[miniskirt]] [[black thighhighs|black]] [[o-ring legwear|o-ring]] thighhighs with [[black garter straps]] and [[black footwear|black]] [[fold-over boots|fold-over]] [[lace-up boots]] with [[colored shoe soles|colored]] [[platform heels|platform]] [[high heel boots|high heels]].
